name: cadence-fog-to-daylight
engine: higgsfield seedance_2_0 std, audio off, free trial
style: A real photograph, 35mm full-frame camera, natural film grain, true-to-life colours, real-world imperfections, no CGI look, no glow, no lens flare, no people. Cards and notes blank or with faint printed ruled lines only: no handwriting, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
vector: the camera only moves forward, from the middle of a dark study room to a cork board on the far wall, never pulls back
acceptance: looks like a real photo shoot (practical effects), not a 3D render
same room, same notes, same board across frames
light: night blue -> dawn grey -> warm morning sun from the window on the RIGHT of the board
each keyframe further forward than the previous one

keyframes.prompt: Study room at blue hour, haze, paper sticky notes and index cards hanging on fishing line at random angles, tall window with a street lamp at the far end.
A few steps further in; notes hang still and turn to the camera; first pale dawn in the window.
Halfway down the room; an empty wooden-framed cork board on the far wall left of the window; cool dawn daylight, haze almost gone.
Board at half the frame, window on its right, cards drifting to it and the first pinned, low early sun warming.
Close to the board, slight angle; half the cards pinned in three columns, others still hanging; warm morning sun from the window on the right.
Front-on, board fills the frame; all pinned except one last yellow note on its line.
Slightly closer, centred on the middle column; everything pinned; the card outlined in sage green washi tape with two dot stickers at the centre.

clips.prompt: The camera slowly moves forward through the dark hazy study room toward the tall window; the hanging notes sway less and turn to face the camera; the window sky starts to turn to the first pale grey of dawn.

Continuing the same slow forward move toward the far wall, an empty cork board comes into view left of the window; the hanging notes line up in rows and columns in front of it; cool dawn daylight fills the room.
Continuing the same forward move at constant speed toward the cork board until it fills half of the frame; cards drift toward the board and the first are pinned; light warms.
Continuing forward until the board fills most of the frame, the window edge on the right; the cards are pinned into three columns; warm morning sun from the right.
clips.note: generated with start frame only (end keyframe broke geometry)

note: Final cut: 4 clips, 20 s. kf4-kf6 kept as references only; the film ends on the last frame of c3b.
